description: This file defines the LoanTransactionComparator class, which implements a comparator for LoanTransaction objects, establishing an order based on transaction dates, submitted date, created date, and other transaction characteristics.

classes.name: LoanTransactionComparator
classes.description: A comparator class that sorts LoanTransaction objects based on multiple criteria, including transaction date, accrual activity, submitted date, created date, income posting status, waiver status, and ID.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Implements comparison logic for LoanTransaction objects, returning an integer indicating order based on various transaction properties.
